headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Strategic Shift to Equipment Supply; WindWorld to Improve Margin Abhishek Jain abhishek.jain@arihantcapital.com 022-42254872 Rohan Baranwal rohan.baranwal@arihantcapital.com Inox Wind Ltd reported revenue of INR 13,543 Mn (+21.0% YoY/+66.4% QoQ), 7.6% above our estimate of INR 12,591 Mn.
EBITDA stood at INR 2,051 Mn (-9.9% YoY/+34.5% QoQ), 25.9% below our estimate of INR 2,768 Mn.
EBITDA margin declined by 520 bps YoY (down by 358 bps QoQ) to 15.15% vs 20.35% in Q2FY26.
PAT stood at INR 686 Mn vs INR 1,206 Mn (-43.2% YoY/+7.0% QoQ), 49.5% below our estimate of INR 1,357 Mn.
valuation: Key Highlights: Strategic Shift to Equipment Supply Prioritises Cash Flows; Targeting ~INR 75,000 Mn by FY28: The company is focusing on order quality, cash flows and balance sheet strength over FY27 volumes, and will not meet its earlier FY27 guidance of ~75% revenue growth at a 20-22% EBITDA margin.
Debtor days are targeted below 150 by end-FY28 (FY26: ~353 days), and management retained its FY28 target of ~INR 75,000 Mn revenue at a ~20% EBITDA margin, with an upward bias.
Its current EBITDA margin of 25-30% is targeted to reach ~40% within 3-4 quarters through cost rationalization and value-added services.

Valuation & Outlook: Inox Wind delivered a mixed Q2FY27, with revenue up 21.0% YoY to INR 13,543 Mn, while EBITDA declined 9.9% YoY to INR 2,051 Mn and EBITDA margin contracted to 15.15% (-520 bps YoY).
